gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans reads with wide-mouthed letters, a body face that never crowds its own shapes. And Gabarito up top, drawn as if with one nib at a single stroke weight, gives the page a loud, expressive voice above it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-mooli: Marker-bold and friendly, Gabarito draws every character with the same plain stroke. Mooli follows with round, open sans letters that stay clear at small sizes, a quieter partner with a modern feel.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-murecho: Gabarito bends its lines like rope or tubing, giving headings a distinctive, expressive look with one nib's worth of stroke. But Murecho keeps the text modern and clean, its sans-serif s curves opening wide at both ends.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-nanum-gothic: Nanum Gothic is the quiet one here, with wide channels leading into each counter. Gabarito is best at thick-jointed, expressive display lines, while the plain sans body is best at steady, contemporary text.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-national-park: National Park draws rounded letters with a clearly open side, as if a pen never changed pressure or angle. And Gabarito does the loud, expressive display work, while the sans body handles the clean, contemporary text.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Gabarito's tubular strokes look like bent copper pipe, a distinctive, expressive heading that stands out immediately. Noto Sans Linear B then lets the eye glide, each bend smooth and unobstructed.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Expressive and distinctive, Gabarito draws its curves at a thread-thin, uniform gauge, so headings feel handmade and bold. Noto Sans Manichaean, a plain sans, reads modern and clean, its e crossbars open-mouthed.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Gabarito's curves meet stems with no swelling at the joins, giving a distinctive display look that feels drawn in one go. But Noto Sans Mongolian is best at modern, neutral text, its sans terminals flaring outward.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Gabarito looks like a bent paperclip, with no thick-to-thin shifts anywhere, an expressive and distinctive heading. And Noto Sans New Tai Lue, a plain sans, offers cupped, unclenched round letters, a quiet strength.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo gives its sans-serif text modern, contemporary c openings you can see through, set under Gabarito's same-gauge, expressive strokes. Pages built this way read smoothly and without fuss.
